teacher_info.intro: I am a native Dutch speaker, but have lived in the USA for over ten years. I gained a lot of experience as a Spanish student on Italki. This experience has been so rewarding that I want to share it with you as a tutor on the Italki platform. As you can see from my profile, I offer two categories of lessons, one is a conversation based lesson, which is intended for intermediate - advanced students. The other lesson is for beginner to intermediate students who don't have much experience with the language and need more guidance and explanation using the lesson materials that I will provide.  I believe in learning through active participation, which means you will be speaking from day one.

teacher_info.about_teacher: I consider myself as a patient teacher and I try to create an environment where students feel comfortable. It's not a problem if you have never spoken the language or have little experience. I can always switch to Dutch, English or Spanish if you get stuck on a sentence or need more explanation in those languages. I will always find a way to guide you through the process
teacher_info.teaching_style: In the conversation classes, the teaching style is relaxed and we will discuss a variety of topics. During this lesson, I will identify and correct any grammar, pronunciation or sentence structure errors. This lesson will focus on increasing vocabulary, making mistakes and becoming more comfortable speaking. The other category of lessons will provide the student with all the tools necessary to speak the language correctly. My lessons are designed to explain grammar in a fun and interactive way where the student applies the concepts by speaking. Using context is very important when teaching something new and I will personalize the lessons based on the needs of the student.

course_info.trial_description: During the practice lesson we will go through what you want to improve and how we can do that so that you get the most out of it. Based on your knowledge of the language, I will make recommendations on what we can focus on, but always in consultation with you.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversational Dutch: Building Fluency Through Conversation
pro_course_detail.description: I think this is the most natural and fun way to improve your language skills. Conversations allow the student to acquire the language both through listening and speaking. We can discuss some topics in particular that are interesting to you or perhaps you prefer that I come up with some topics. During the conversation, I will identify and correct you on any grammar, pronunciation or sentence structure errors. The key for this lesson is to increase vocabulary, make mistakes and become acquainted with the language.

pro_course_detail.title: Start Learning Dutch From Scratch
pro_course_detail.description: This lesson is aimed at students who want to learn Dutch but have little to no experience with the language. My lessons are designed to explain grammar in a fun and interactive way where the student applies the concepts by speaking. Using context is very important when teaching something new and I will personalize the lessons based on the needs of the student. The lessons materials that I provide will be in English.
